Healthcare CRM

Every Relationship Your Practice Manages, in One Place

A practice doesn't just manage patients. It manages relationships with providers, billing vendors, attorneys handling injury cases, insurance adjusters, and internal staff, and most of that today lives across email threads, sticky notes and someone's memory.

PMEX's healthcare CRM centralizes every one of those relationships, so anyone on your team can pick up a case or a conversation exactly where it left off, without calling around to piece together the history.
